name: How to Keep Your Remodel Schedule from Spiraling Out of Control

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Keeping your remodeling timeline on track can feel like herding cats, especially with multiple trades involved. But with a solid plan, it's totally manageable. First, ensure your renovation plans account for permit approvals and inspection points. You can't start certain work until those green lights are given, and rushing it can lead to bigger delays later. Build buffer time into your schedule, too. Material delays happen, and sometimes trades can't be perfectly sequenced. A little wiggle room means a small hiccup doesn't derail the whole project. Regular check-ins with your contractor are also vital. These aren't just chats; they're opportunities to review progress, anticipate potential issues, and make sure everyone's aligned. And don't forget documentation! Any change orders need to clearly state how they affect the schedule and budget, and these should always be in writing. This transparency prevents misunderstandings and keeps the project moving forward. For complex remodels in the East Bay, getting a professional involved early, especially one like Frasheski Construction who manages projects hands-on, can really help you navigate these scheduling challenges effectively.
